channel.title: Pier & Point · UCSF Illinois Street Garage
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for UCSF Illinois Street Garage (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · UCSF Illinois Street Garage: The garage's opening milestone was dated May 2023 although its own text said only the year is used; it is now dated 2023 and notes that the UCSF Real Estate page behind it returns 403. Clark Construction's readable release confirms the 9-level, 500-space garage on Block 34 but not the 590 Illinois St address or the opening date, which remain open questions on the record. The Commons photo credit no longer says it was taken from a departing flight.
item.description: The garage's opening milestone was dated May 2023 although its own text said only the year is used; it is now dated 2023 and notes that the UCSF Real Estate page behind it returns 403. The Commons photo credit no longer says it was taken from a departing flight. Source: Clark Construction Group, 2021-09-23 (https://www.clarkconstruction.com/news/clark-breaks-ground-ucsfs-new-clinical-building-mission-bay); UCSF Real Estate, Bayfront Medical Building and Illinois Street Garage (https://realestate.ucsf.edu/projects/bayfront-medical-building-and-illinois-street-garage); Wikimedia Commons, aerial photo file page (https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Aerial_photo_of_San_Francisco%27s_Mission_Bay,_ballpark,_and_Caltrain_area.jpg).

item.title: Complete · UCSF Illinois Street Garage: Illinois Street Garage (590 Illinois St), 9 stories / 500 spaces, opens as part of UCSF's Block 34 Clinical Building and Parking Garage project; UCSF Real Estate's project page (which returned 403 and could not be read on 2026-09-29) is cited for it and the opening is commonly reported as May 15, 2023, but no readable source gives the month, so only the year is used here (~2023)
item.description: Illinois Street Garage (590 Illinois St), 9 stories / 500 spaces, opens as part of UCSF's Block 34 Clinical Building and Parking Garage project; UCSF Real Estate's project page (which returned 403 and could not be read on 2026-09-29) is cited for it and the opening is commonly reported as May 15, 2023, but no readable source gives the month, so only the year is used here (~2023). Source: UCSF Real Estate.

item.title: Under construction · UCSF Illinois Street Garage: Construction begins on the Illinois Street Garage portion of the Block 34 project specifically (500 spaces, nine levels), per Clark Construction's own press release: "Clark started construction on the garage portion of the development in April 2021" -- distinct from the clinical building's own Sept/Oct 2021 groundbreaking (Apr 2021)
